title: How to Write a Strong Research Question for Research Papers
skills: develop a focused and researchable question
refine broad topics into specific lines of inquiry
evaluate whether a research question is clear, manageable, and arguable
use a research question to guide evidence gathering and paper organization
alignment_note: Provides practical guidance for developing strong research questions that are focused, specific, researchable, and useful for guiding academic papers. Supports inquiry, research planning, source selection, argument development, and academic writing across high school English courses.
